sanskrit: kṛṇomi te prāṇāpānau jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛṇutāṃ dīrgham āyuḥ svasti | vaivasvatena prahitān yamadūtāṃś carata ārād apa sedhāmi sarvān ||
english: I make for you breath and vital breath; let old age and death make long life and well-being. The messengers of Yama dispatched by Vaivasvata, all those who roam about — I drive them far away.

sanskrit: ārād arātiṃ nirṛtiṃ paro grāhiṃ kravyādaḥ piśacān | rakṣo yat sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ tat tama ivāpa hanmasi ||
english: Far away — malice, dissolution, the seizing demon beyond, flesh-devouring Piśācas; whatever evil being there is, every Rakṣas — that we smite away like darkness.

sanskrit: agneṣ ṭe prāṇam amṛtād āyuṣmato manave jātavedasaḥ | yathā na riṣyā amṛtaḥ sajūr asas tat te kṛṇomi tad u te sam ṛdhyatām ||
english: From immortal Agni Jātavedas, long-lived and cognizant of all births, I take breath for you, as for Manu — so that you may be unharmed and immortal in fellowship. This I do for you; may this be fulfilled for you.

sanskrit: śive te stāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī asantāpe adhiśriyau | śaṃ te sūrya ā tapati śaṃ vāto vātu te hṛde | śivā abhi kṣarantu tvā- -āpo divyāḥ payasvatīḥ śivās te santv oṣadhīḥ ||
english: May Heaven and Earth be auspicious to you, resting upon you without scorching heat, shining with splendour. May the sun warm you auspiciously; may the wind blow auspiciously upon your heart. May the heavenly, milk-rich waters flow auspiciously over you; may the plants be auspicious to you.

sanskrit: ut tvāhārṣam adharasyād uttarāṃ pṛthivīm abhi | tatra tvādityau rakṣatāṃ sūryāś candramasā ubhā ||
english: I have lifted you up from the lower region toward the higher earth. There let both Ādityas — Sun and Moon together — guard you.

sanskrit: yat te vāsaḥ paridhānaṃ yāṃ nīviṃ kṛṇuṣe tvam | śivaṃ te tanve tat kṛṇmaḥ saṃsparśe 'dhrūkṣṇam astu te ||
english: The garment you put on for wearing, the girdle you fasten about yourself — we make that auspicious for your body; may it be unharmful in contact with you.

sanskrit: yat kṣureṇa marcayatā sutejasā vaptā vapasi keśaśmasru | śumbhaṃ mukhaṃ mainam āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ ||
english: When, with a razor of fine keenness, the barber shaves off hair and beard — making the face beautiful, let it not rob this one of life.

sanskrit: śivau te stāṃ vrīhiyavāv abalāsāv adomadhau | etau yakṣmaṃ vi bādhete etau muñcato aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Auspicious to you be rice and barley — not causing weakness, not causing oppression. These two repel disease; these two release from distress.

sanskrit: yad aśnāsi yat pibasi dhānyaṃ kṛṣyāḥ payaḥ | ādyaṃ yad anādyaṃ sarvaṃ te annam aviṣaṃ kṛṇomi ||
english: Whatever you eat, whatever you drink — the grain, the produce of tillage, the milk — what is to be eaten and what is not to be eaten: all food I make free of poison for you.

sanskrit: ahne ca tvā rātraye ca- -ubhābhyāṃ pari dadhmasi | arāyebhyo jighatsubhyaḥ imaṃ naḥ pari rakṣata ||
english: To both Day and Night together we entrust you. From the greedy devouring demons — protect this one of ours on all sides.

sanskrit: śataṃ te 'yutaṃ hāyanā dve yuge trīṇi catvāri santu | indrāgnī viśve devā anu manyantām ahṛṇīyamānāḥ ||
english: May there be for you a hundred, ten thousand years of life; two ages, three, four. May Indra and Agni, may all the gods consent to this without anger.

sanskrit: śarade tvā hemantāya vasantāya griṣmāya pari dadhmasi | varṣāṇi tubhyaṃ syonāni yeṣu vardhanta oṣadhīḥ ||
english: For autumn, for winter, for spring, for summer we entrust you. May the rainy seasons be gentle for you — those in which the plants flourish.

sanskrit: mṛtyur īśe dvipadāṃ mṛtyur īśe catuṣpadām | tasmāt tvā mṛtyor gopater ud dharāmi sa mā mṛthāḥ ||
english: Death rules the two-footed; Death rules the four-footed. From that Death, lord of cattle, I lift you up. May he not slay you.

sanskrit: so 'riṣṭa na mariṣyasi na mariṣyasi mā bibheḥ | na vai tatra pra mīyante no yanty adharaṃ rajaḥ ||
english: Unharmed, you shall not die; you shall not die — fear not. Truly, they do not perish there; they do not go to the lower realm of dust.

sanskrit: sarvo vai tatra jīvati gaur aśvaḥ puruṣaḥ paśuḥ | yatredaṃ brahma kriyate paridhir jīvanāya kam ||
english: Truly everything lives there — cow, horse, man, beast — where this sacred formula is performed as a protective enclosure for life, for bliss.

sanskrit: pari tvā pātu samānebhyo 'bhicārāt sabandhubhyaḥ | amamrir bhavāmṛto 'tijīvo mā te hāsiṣur asavaḥ śarīram ||
english: May it guard you on all sides from the sorcery of kindred folk, from those of equal standing. Be one who does not wither; be immortal, one who outlives; may your vital forces not abandon your body.

sanskrit: viśve tvā devā amṛtena bibhratv adhivaktā paśupatiṣ ṭe astu | anāmayat savitā te kṛṇotv ā tvā prāṇo viśatu jīvanāya ||
english: May all the gods sustain you with immortality; may Paśupati be your advocate. May Savitṛ make you free of sickness; may breath enter you for the sake of life.

sanskrit: ye mṛtyava ekaśataṃ yā nāṣṭrātijīvyā | muñcantu tasmāt tvā devā agner vaiśvānarād adhi ||
english: The hundred-and-one deaths, the fatal nights that are not to be outlived — from those let the gods release you, above and beyond Agni Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit: rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinam ā jigharmi mitraṃ prathiṣṭham upa yāmi śarma | śiśāno agniḥ kratubhiḥ samiddhaḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam ||
english: I kindle the strong slayer of Rakṣases; I approach the shelter of the most widely spread Friend. Agni, whetted and kindled with rites — may he protect us from harm by day, by night.

sanskrit: ayodaṃṣṭrān arciṣā vāvṛdhānān upa spṛśa jātavedaḥ samiddhaḥ | ā jihvayā mūradevān rabhasva kravyādo vṛṣṭvāpi dhatsvāsan ||
english: Touch with your flame those who grow strong with iron fangs, O Jātavedas, when kindled. With your tongue seize the fool-gods; having consumed the flesh-eaters, close your mouth upon them.

sanskrit: ubhobhayāvinn upa dehi daṃṣṭrā hiṃsraḥ śiśāno 'varaṃ paraṃ ca | utāntarikṣe pari yāhy agne jambhaiḥ saṃ dhehy abhi yātudhānān ||
english: O bearer of both kinds, apply your fangs — fierce and whetted — upon the lower and the upper. And roam through the atmosphere, O Agni; crush the sorcerers with your jaws; fall upon them.

sanskrit: agne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhindhi hiṃsrāśanir harasā hantv enam | pra parvāṇi jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi kravyāt kraviṣṇur vi cinoty enam ||
english: O Agni, pierce the skin of the sorcerer; may the fierce thunderbolt strike him down with heat. Shatter his joints, O Jātavedas; the flesh-eating fire, hungering for raw flesh, picks him apart.

sanskrit: yajñair iṣūḥ saṃnamamāno agne vācā śalyām̐ aśanibhir dihānaḥ | tābhir vidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān pratīco bāhūn prati bhaṅdhy eṣām ||
english: O Agni, bending your arrows with sacrificial rites, smearing your shafts with speech and with thunderbolts — with those, pierce the sorcerers in their hearts; shatter the arms of those who oppose us.

sanskrit: yatredānīṃ paśyasi jātavedas tiṣṭhantam agna uta vā carantam | utāntarikṣe patantaṃ yātudhānaṃ tamasā vidhya sarvā śiśānaḥ ||
english: Wherever you now see him, O Jātavedas, O Agni — standing still or moving about — or a sorcerer flying through the atmosphere: pierce him through with darkness, wholly, you who are whetted.

sanskrit: utārabdhāc chṛṇīhi jātaveda utārebhāṇād ṛṣṭibhir yātudhānāt | agne pūrvo ni jahi śośucāna āmādaḥ kṣviṅkās tam adantv enīḥ ||
english: And shatter the sorcerer with your spears when seized, O Jātavedas; and when he is about to fly. Strike first, O blazing Agni; may the raw-flesh-eating female spirits, shrieking, devour him.

sanskrit: iha pra brūhi yatamaḥ so agne yo yātudhāno ya idaṃ śṛṇoti | tam ā rabhasva samidhā yaviṣṭha nṛcakṣasaś cakṣuṣe randhayaitam ||
english: Declare here, O Agni, which one he is — the sorcerer who hears this. Seize him, O youngest one, with fuel; surrender him to the sight of the man-watching eye.

sanskrit: tīkṣṇenāgne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñaṃ prāñcaṃ vasubhyaḥ pra ṇaya pracetaḥ | hiṃsraṃ rakṣāṃsy abhi śośucānaḥ mā tvā dabhan yātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ ||
english: With your keen eye, O Agni, guard the sacrifice; lead it forward eastward to the Vasus, O wise one. Blazing against the fierce Rakṣases — may the sorcerers not deceive you, O watcher of men.

sanskrit: nṛcakṣā rakṣaḥ prati paśya vikṣu tasya trīṇi prati śṛṇīhy agrā | tasyāgne pṛṣṭīr harasā śṛṇīhi tredhā mūlaṃ yātudhānasya vṛśca ||
english: O watcher of men, look upon the Rakṣas among the settlements; shatter his three foremost points. Shatter his ribs, O Agni, with your heat; cleave the root of the sorcerer into three.
